title: agropyron corsicum
intro: Agropyron corsicum, commonly known as Corsican wheatgrass or Corsican brome, is a species of grass within the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron corsicum include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Agropyron corsicum on human health, but its traditional use as a medicinal herb suggests its potential as a valuable natural remedy.
